name: Darius Jackson
bio:
Darius's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching his father restore classic cars. He honed his skills at a local body shop, quickly mastering the art of custom paint jobs and vinyl application. His meticulous attention to detail and ability to envision striking designs caught the eye of a scout from Prema Racing. 

Since joining Prema, Darius has become an integral part of the team, ensuring that the cars not only perform flawlessly but also look the part. He thrives on the pressure of delivering high-quality finishes under tight deadlines, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible with paint and design. His innovative approach to paint techniques, coupled with his unwavering loyalty to Prema, make him a valuable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly faded sides with textured top.
physical.description: Darius is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always color-codes his tools and equipment.
Keeps a sketchbook filled with potential car livery designs.
Can identify any paint color by its name and code.
